title: Account Executive - Skillet
jobDescription: Skillet is an AI-powered platform for roleplay, manager coaching, and call preparation built for life sciences commercial teams. We help teams practice the high-stakes conversations that matter the most, from product launches and customer interactions to manager coaching and field readiness, because when it comes to practice, realise drives results. Skillet operates under the Wayground brand with its own dedicated focus and mission. We are building a new way for life sciences organizations to prepare their teams for critical conversations by combining deep domain understanding, thoughtful curriculum design, and AI-powered simulations. We’re looking for an Account Executive who is passionate about building relationships, solving customer problems, and helping organizations unlock the value of AI-powered learning. This is a high-impact role where you'll combine consultative selling, strategic account planning, and product expertise to drive meaningful customer outcomes while contributing to Skillet's next stage of growth. What you'll do Own the full sales cycle from prospecting and discovery through negotiation and close. Manage both inbound and outbound opportunities while consistently building a healthy pipeline. Understand customer challenges and position Skillet as a strategic solution through thoughtful discovery and tailored product demonstrations. Build trusted relationships with stakeholders across Sales Enablement, Commercial Excellence, Learning & Development, and Sales Leadership. Develop territory and account strategies that drive sustainable pipeline growth and revenue. Partner closely with Marketing, Customer Success, Product, and Leadership to deliver an exceptional customer experience. Maintain an in-depth understanding of Skillet's AI-powered platform, new capabilities, and industry trends. Accurately forecast pipeline, maintain CRM hygiene, and use data to guide sales strategy and decision-making. Consistently achieve and exceed revenue targets while contributing insights that help improve our sales playbook. Who you are You have 2+ years of experience selling B2B Saa S solutions, preferably to customers in the US or Europe. You have experience managing complex sales cycles and engaging multiple stakeholders. You're a strong communicator who can simplify complex ideas and build trust quickly. You enjoy understanding customer problems before proposing solutions and thrive in a consultative sales environment. You're naturally curious, coachable, and continuously looking to improve your craft. You're organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple opportunities simultaneously. You're confident using CRM tools and sales technology to manage pipeline and forecasting. You enjoy working cross-functionally and believe the best customer outcomes come from strong internal collaboration. Experience selling to life sciences, healthcare, medical devices, or enterprise learning and enablement teams is a plus. Familiarity with AI-powered products or enterprise Saa S platforms is a bonus. We're looking for someone who enjoys getting deep into a product, understanding how people actually learn and practice, and building experiences that feel authentic to the conversations they face in the real world. At Skillet, we believe great work happens through collaboration, curiosity, and ownership. We work together in person, exchange ideas freely, and build with speed and care. We offer comprehensive healthcare benefits for employees and their families, invest in learning and development, and provide meals, snacks, and commute support for our Bangalore-based team. Skillet is an equal opportunity employer, and we believe diversity is key to our success.

title: Product Design, Intern - Skillet
jobDescription: Skillet is an AI-powered platform for roleplay, manager coaching, and call preparation built for life sciences commercial teams. jobDescription: Skillet is an AI-powered platform for roleplay, manager coaching, and call preparation built for life sciences commercial teams. We are looking for a Curriculum Designer who can translate business goals, complex life sciences products, and real-world commercial scenarios into clear learning objective and highly realistic practice experiences. You will work at the intersection of life sciences, learning design, and AI, shaping how commercial teams prepare for conversations that directly impact their effectiveness in the field. What you'll do: Translate business goals, performance needs, and commercial priorities into clear learning objectives and practice roleplay activities. Design realistic AI-powered roleplay scenarios that help life sciences commercial teams practice high-stakes conversations. Use AI tools to accelerate curriculum development, content creation, research, personalization, and learning design workflows. Continuously improve curricula and practice experiences based on learner feedback, customer needs, and performance outcomes.
